title: Excellent staff, massages, and atmosphere
text: We had a wonderful couples’ massage here, and we’re so glad we did. The staff was very sweet when our uber took us to a different location, allowing us to keep our appointment (but shortened from one hour to 45 minutes, understandably). The eastern decor is quite lovely. The massage room is dim and comfortable, and the masseuses know what they’re doing. It was a sweet touch afterward to be directed to the bar for some tea and baklava.
author: feminnis

title: Kaira

title: Clean, very beautiful and harmonious place. Naomigave ne a really wonderful and professional massage. I really recommend
text:
The place is very beautiful, harmonious and clean. We were warmly and professionally welcomed and all of us, five persons, could get a massage at the same time, which was really nice. All  of us were very happy with the massage we got. I am a SPA therapist myself and I would give the place and my SPA therapist Naomi  a full five star for the treatment she gave me. I highly recommend this place and will definitely come back the next time I visit Barcelona. 
Nina, Finland
